subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>; Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>; Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>; Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Hi all — aiming to publish the canonical Confluence pages + export the field PDFs by EOD Thu.

I need final sign-off on three items that keep coming back from field feedback + the questionnaire bank:

1) Audit log scope wording (what is logged today vs “available on request”)
2) Retention defaults (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and how we describe configurability
3) Roadmap phrasing (avoid commitments; keep it helpful for SEs)

Attached are the final-candidate docs with the disputed paragraphs highlighted:
- Security_FAQ_v2_FINAL-CANDIDATE_2026-02-10.docx
- OnePagers_Pack_v2_FINAL-CANDIDATE_2026-02-10.pptx
- RFP_Library_Approved_Language_Delta_2026-02-10.docx

Proposed resolution (please reply “approved” or suggest edits):

AUDIT LOGS (FAQ + one-pager)
- Say explicitly: “Audit logs capture administrative and security-relevant actions in the Redwood Console/control plane.”
- List high-level categories only (login events, API key/service account lifecycle, org/project configuration changes, role changes, model endpoint configuration changes).
- Avoid claiming full request/response content is logged.
- For export: “Available via Console download and/or API where enabled; SIEM forwarding options may vary by deployment and plan; contact support for enablement.”

RETENTION (retention one-pager + FAQ)
- Default: “Redwood retains audit logs and operational logs for a limited period to operate the service; retention durations vary by log type and plan.”
- Hosted: state a default number only where we’re comfortable (currently 30 days for operational logs in Console views; audit log retention longer for enterprise plans) BUT I’d prefer we don’t lock exact numbers unless GRC is comfortable.
- Dedicated: “Retention can be configured within supported ranges; longer retention available by request.”
- Private: “Customer controls retention in their environment; Redwood components follow customer-configured retention.”

ROADMAP PHRASES
- Replace “will” with “planned” / “in progress” and add: “timelines subject to change.”
- Add a standard line: “Please route customer requests for roadmap details through the account team; Redwood can share under NDA where appropriate.”

If I don’t hear back by noon tomorrow I’ll assume approval and proceed (unless that’s an issue).

Thanks,
Naomi
—
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance PM
Redwood Inference


---

From: Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Naomi — +1 on keeping audit log scope high level.

Two tweaks from Security Eng perspective:

1) Don’t say “login events” without qualification. We have Console auth events and SSO/SAML assertions, but customers sometimes interpret that as full IdP telemetry. Suggest: “authentication events to the Redwood Console (e.g., successful/failed console login attempts, SSO events)”.

2) Export phrasing: we should avoid implying a public API for audit logs for every plan. Current reality is Console export + enterprise enablement for streaming. Maybe:

“Audit logs can be exported (e.g., CSV download from the Console; additional export/forwarding mechanisms may be available for enterprise plans).”

Everything else looks fine.

Kevin


---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Agree w/ Kevin.

Audit logs:
- Categories are good.
- Strongly recommend we remove any sentence that could be read as “we log all API calls” unless we’re specifically referring to admin actions (API key creation, endpoint config, etc.).

Retention:
- Please do NOT put exact defaults in the customer-facing pack unless GRC confirms they’re stable. We’ve had retention behavior change with plan + region + telemetry pipeline updates.
- Safer: “default retention is limited and varies by log type; longer retention available by request for certain plans.”

Roadmap:
- Fine. Also add: “Roadmap items are not commitments and are subject to change.” (explicit).

If you incorporate those edits, Security Eng approves.

Marcus


---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>; Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 12:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Naomi,

From GRC: agree with Marcus on retention numbers — avoid exact days/months in broadly shareable collateral.

What we can safely say:
- “Retention varies by data type and deployment mode.”
- “Customers can request deletion of customer content per the agreement and support process.”
- “In Private, the customer controls retention and deletion within their environment.”

We should also avoid “SIEM integration” unless we clarify it’s “export/forwarding options” and may require an enterprise plan or professional services. (Procurement teams latch onto “integration” as “included.”)

If the above is incorporated, GRC approves.

Olga


---

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 1:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Adding Legal lens:

1) Roadmap: I strongly prefer the explicit sentence Marcus suggested (“not commitments; subject to change”). Keep it consistent across FAQ, one-pagers, and RFP library.

2) Retention: avoid “we retain for X days” unless it’s contractually guaranteed. “Limited retention” + “varies” + “by request” is safer.

3) Audit logs: be careful about “security-relevant actions” being interpreted as “complete forensic logging.” You can keep it, but consider: “security and administrative actions in the Redwood Console” (that’s clearer and bounded).

Legal approves with those edits.

Michael


---

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>; Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Docs/publishing note:

If we remove exact retention numbers, can we add a “How to get specifics” line?

Something like: “For plan-specific retention details, contact your Redwood account team or submit a security evidence request (NDA may be required).”

This helps reduce back-and-forth for SEs without locking us into numbers.

Also: please avoid “API” wording unless it’s actually GA. We can say “export” and then keep the internal evidence index pointing to the current mechanisms (restricted).

Elliot


---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>; Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>; Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>; Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 11:07 AM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

Thanks all — I’ve incorporated edits across FAQ v2, audit logging one-pager, retention one-pager, and the RFP library.

Net changes:

AUDIT LOGS
- Updated to: “Audit logs capture administrative actions and authentication events in the Redwood Console/control plane.”
- Authentication wording now: “Console authentication events (e.g., successful/failed login attempts; SSO events)”
- Removed any ambiguous “API calls are logged” language. Only admin actions (API key lifecycle, role changes, endpoint config changes, org/project settings).
- Export wording now: “Audit logs can be exported (e.g., via Console export). Additional forwarding/export options may be available for enterprise plans.”

RETENTION
- Removed all numeric defaults.
- Now: “Retention varies by data type, deployment mode, and plan. Redwood retains certain logs for a limited period to operate, secure, and support the service.”
- Added “How to get specifics” line (Elliot’s suggestion): “For plan-specific retention details, contact your Redwood account team; NDA may be required for certain materials.”
- Dedicated: “configurable within supported ranges; longer retention may be available by request.”
- Private: “customer controls retention and deletion in their environment.”

ROADMAP
- Standard sentence added everywhere: “Roadmap items are not commitments and are subject to change.”
- Removed “will” language.

Can you reply with explicit APPROVED so I can log the approvals for PM-1847 and proceed with Confluence publish + PDF export?

Naomi


---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>; Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>; Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>; Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 4:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Final approvals needed — Security FAQ v2 + one-pagers (audit logs / retention / roadmap wording)

APPROVED (Security Eng) — the revised scope/retention/roadmap language looks good.

Marcus


Reply-all approvals received earlier today in the same thread (for audit trail):

- Olga Petrov (GRC): APPROVED
- Michael Grant (Legal): APPROVED
- Kevin Osei (Security SME): APPROVED
- Elliot Price (Docs): APPROVED (publish-ready with the “how to get specifics” line)
